title: Our
subtitle: At Ingeri, we support each child according to their age, pace, and individual needs. Our program combines structured learning, hands-on experiences, and moments of exploration to nurture the child's overall development.

creche.name: La P'tite Crèche Ingeri

pillars.title: Sensory and motor awakening:
pillars.desc: Exploration through the senses, movement, manipulation, and discovery of the environment

pillars.title: Language development:
pillars.desc: Conversation, stories, songs, and daily interactions to enrich communication

pillars.title: Growing independence:
pillars.desc: Supporting the child in their first steps toward independence, at their own pace

pillars.title: Emotional and social development:
pillars.desc: Creating a secure setting where the child learns to express emotions and interact with others

pillars.title: Spiritual awakening:
pillars.desc: Discovering Christian values through songs, prayers, and moments suited to young children

creche.calendar: Mon–Fri. Parent meetings & mini-workshops held regularly.

pillars.title: Early academic learning:
pillars.desc: Language, pre-reading, writing, mathematics, discovery of the world, and first scientific concepts.

pillars.title: Creativity and expression:
pillars.desc: Artistic activities, music, physical expression, and creative projects.

pillars.title: Thinking and curiosity:
pillars.desc: Observation, experimentation, problem-solving, and learning through play.

pillars.title: Social skills:
pillars.desc: Cooperation, communication, self-confidence, and group life.

pillars.title: Cultural and spiritual openness:
pillars.desc: Discovering the world, cultures, and Christian values.
